verdict.rationale: First-party support docs describe a fully online exercise flow: the employee opens My Equity, clicks Exercise Now on an eligible grant, selects the number of shares, and e-signs the exercise documents, with spousal consent where applicable. Signatures can be drawn, uploaded or typed via an emailed link. The cap table also links award agreements to later exercise actions and stock certificates, but nothing documents how the employee pays the exercise price online or confirms shares are issued automatically. missing for 10: documented online payment of the exercise price, explicit evidence of automatic share or certificate issuance after exercise, independent or hands-on corroboration.
